versions.subject: New Rules
versions.detection:
selection_iwr:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\powershell.exe'
        - '\pwsh.exe'
        - '\cmd.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'Invoke-WebRequest'
        - 'iwr '
        - 'wget '
        - 'curl '
selection_flags:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' -ur'
        - ' -o'
selection_susp_locations:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '\AppData\'
        - '\Users\Public\'
        - '\Temp\'
        - '%AppData%'
        - '%Temp%'
        - '%Public%'
        - '\Desktop\'
        - 'C:\Windows\'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\powershell.exe", "*\\pwsh.exe", "*\\cmd.exe") CommandLine IN ("*Invoke-WebRequest*", "*iwr *", "*wget *", "*curl *") CommandLine IN ("* -ur*", "* -o*") CommandLine IN ("*\\AppData\\*", "*\\Users\\Public\\*", "*\\Temp\\*", "*%AppData%*", "*%Temp%*", "*%Public%*", "*\\Desktop\\*", "*C:\\Windows\\*")
